verdict.rationale: kongctl supports declarative configuration for managing resources as code, which implies bulk creation/update of gateway entities, and the Konnect API can list AI Gateways in bulk, but there is no documented batch/bulk request API for processing many AI traffic items at once. missing for 10: explicit bulk operation endpoints or CLI commands for batch processing, evidence of bulk actions on AI Gateway entities beyond declarative config, independent confirmation of bulk workflows.
